claims.claim_text: 作者原本承諾 7 月 7 日出 1.4
claims.evidence: Jun 24 Bun v1.4 ships July 7th.

claims.claim_text: 距上一個穩定版至今已經三個月，中間只剩「下一版就會有」的重複貼文
claims.note: 已改回來源的原始框架（距最後一個穩定版三個月，而非從 7/7 承諾算起）。
claims.evidence: It's now three months and counting since the last stable release.

claims.claim_text: 儲存庫堆了超過 5,000 個未處理 PR
claims.evidence: The project has over 5k open pull requests, which is the largest number of pull requests I've seen.

claims.claim_text: 文章作者形容是「我看過最大的數字」
claims.note: 已加上「文章」二字明確指向 Piirainen 本人，避免讀成 Bun 維護者的話。
claims.evidence: The project has over 5k open pull requests, which is the largest number of pull requests I've seen.

claims.claim_text: GitHub 官方建議單一分支的安全上限其實低於 1,000
claims.note: 已補上「單一分支」限定詞。
claims.evidence: GitHub recommends staying under 1,000 open PRs against a single branch before mergeability checks start timing out.

claims.claim_text: Zig 語言作者 Andrew Kelley 讀過程式碼後直言「我們越看越心驚——到處是縫縫補補的 hack」
claims.evidence: We became increasingly horrified at the programming practices we saw in Bun's codebase. Hacks on top of hacks.

claims.claim_text: 重寫打的旗號是記憶體安全，Rust 版本裡的 unsafe block 數量卻顯示這個承諾沒有真正兌現
claims.evidence: The number of unsafe blocks in the Rust code suggests the rewrite did not deliver the memory safety that was given as the reason for doing the rewrite

claims.claim_text: 同一個月裡自動化 agent 貢獻了 15,800 次 commit，人類負責人只有 790 次
claims.evidence: In the past month, 15.8k commits came from robobun, 1.6k commits from autofix-ci[bot], and 790 commits from Jarred.

claims.claim_text: 利用 obj instanceof ObjP 的分支誤預測，讓 CPU 投機執行 obj.ptr[0]，藉此洩漏 TypedArray 背後儲存區的 64 位元指標
claims.evidence: The branch `obj instanceof ObjP` performs a type check, i.e., a branch. To mistrain the branch prediction, we call the gadget many times on real `ObjP` instances, then call it on a different object with an attacker-controlled memory layout `ObjI`.

claims.claim_text: 搭配樹狀 pseudo-LRU 快取汰換放大單次記憶體存取的訊號
claims.evidence: Tree-based PLRU organizes each cache set as a binary tree whose nodes point to the side used least recently… the timing of a single cache event can be arbitrarily amplified such that it leads to a lot of L1 hits (faster) compared to lots of L1 misses.

claims.claim_text: 實際洩漏速率來到「12 bit/s，準確率 99%」
claims.evidence: In production, we achieved a leakage rate of up to 12 bit/s with an accuracy of more than 99%.

claims.claim_text: 遠快於 2021 年那一版約 120 bit/h 的速度
claims.evidence: the previous attack relied mostly on repetition to amplify a single cache access, and therefore, was slowly leaking 120 bit/h.

claims.claim_text: 攻擊者靠 Durable Objects 搭配 WebSocket 心跳把執行環境留在原地，繞過原本 30 秒的 CPU 時間上限
claims.evidence: For the purposes of conducting this attack, the relevant limits were 30 seconds of CPU time and 1,000 subrequests per invocation. The attacker opens a persistent WebSocket to a Durable Object worker and sends regular keep-alive messages.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 已在 2025 年 9 月導入 Memory Protection Keys
claims.evidence: In September 2025, we deployed in-process isolation for Workers using Memory Protection Keys (MPK).

claims.claim_text: 並整合 V8 Sandbox，目標是把原始 64 位元指標從大部分 JavaScript heap 裡拿掉
claims.note: 已改為「目標是」並加上「大部分」，恢復來源 final goal／large parts 的強度。
claims.evidence: The V8 memory sandbox's final goal is to remove raw 64-bit pointers from large parts of the JavaScript heap, which reduces the usefulness of many memory-corruption primitives.

claims.claim_text: 「依成本與選擇性動態切換 kNN 與 ANN 向量搜尋」
claims.evidence: SQL dynamically evaluates queries and switches between kNN and ANN vector search based on cost and selectivity.

claims.claim_text: 全文搜尋那一側用 BM25 排序，搭配語言感知的斷詞與詞形還原
claims.evidence: It automatically applies language-aware word breaking and stemming to expand user input across related word forms. The user queries for "run," but the engine understands "ran," "running," and "runs".

claims.claim_text: 向量那一側靠微軟研究院的 DiskANN 技術
claims.evidence: In 2025, SQL embraced DiskANN... DiskANN showed that approximate vector search could remain fast and accurate across millions, even billions, of vectors without requiring enormous amounts of memory.

claims.claim_text: 兩條路徑算出的排序再用 Reciprocal Rank Fusion 合併成一份結果
claims.evidence: Each produces its own ranked results, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) combines those rankings into a single result set, optionally weighting one search more heavily than the other.

claims.claim_text: 查詢改寫、意圖偵測、結果融合與重排都能直接在 SQL 裡跑完
claims.evidence: Every step in a comprehensive hybrid search flow can be orchestrated in SQL... Query rewriting and intent detection can improve the searches before they run, RRF can fuse the results, and reranking can refine the final order.

claims.claim_text: 先在篩選欄位上加索引，撐不住流量後在查詢前面掛一層快取，讀多寫少的報表流量再切到獨立的 read replica
claims.evidence: creating an index on the column being filtered. Now, several months later… a cache in front of the query. A year after that… a read replica with reporting traffic routed to it.

claims.claim_text: 「前面每一種修法，都是把某份資料的副本放到來源之外的地方」
claims.evidence: each one of the previous fixes placed a copy of some data somewhere other than its source.

claims.claim_text: 實例是使用者更新個人資料後卻在別處看到舊版本
claims.evidence: a user updates a profile, reloads the page, but still sees the previous value.

claims.claim_text: 後續要談的 denormalization、materialized view、專用讀取儲存、fan-out 與 CQRS
claims.evidence: Indexes, denormalization, caching, read replicas, materialized views, purpose-built read stores, fan-out on write versus read, and CQRS.

claims.claim_text: 文章也把「一致性」拆成兩種不同定義
claims.evidence: Two different definitions of consistency, and the bugs caused by treating them as one

claims.claim_text: 「模型收到的指令與資料是同一串 token，這串序列裡沒有任何標記能區分命令與資訊」
claims.evidence: A language model receives instructions and data as a single sequence of tokens, and that sequence contains no marker separating commands from information.

claims.claim_text: 間接注入的例子是 EchoLeak——郵件裡藏著的指令能讓 Microsoft 365 Copilot 外洩內部檔案
claims.evidence: EchoLeak was an example of the indirect route... A single email could cause Microsoft 365 Copilot to retrieve a company's internal files and transmit them to an external server, with no user interaction.

claims.claim_text: 「lethal trifecta」三條件
claims.evidence: Access to private data... Exposure to untrusted content... A channel to send data out or act externally

claims.claim_text: nullifAI 這類手法能把反向 shell 藏進序列化的模型檔
claims.evidence: In early 2025, ReversingLabs documented a technique named nullifAI, in which malicious models uploaded to Hugging Face concealed a reverse shell... inside a Python pickle file.

claims.claim_text: Protect AI 檢查超過四百萬個模型，在超過五萬個模型裡標記出約 35.2 萬個不安全或可疑問題
claims.note: 已補上「超過五萬個模型」，修正單位誤解（35.2 萬是問題數分佈在 5 萬+模型中，不是 35.2 萬個模型）。
claims.evidence: Protect AI, which scans models hosted on Hugging Face, has examined more than four million and flagged roughly 352,000 as carrying unsafe or suspicious issues, across more than fifty thousand models.

claims.claim_text: Meta 的「Agents Rule of Two」則建議 agent 最多只能同時具備三種高風險屬性裡的兩種
claims.evidence: Meta's Agents Rule of Two is a simpler operational version, recommending that an agent satisfy at most two of three risky properties

claims.claim_text: x86-64 用四層分頁表，48 位元虛擬位址拆成四段 9 位元索引加 12 位元偏移
claims.evidence: A 48-bit virtual address is divided into four 9-bit index fields (one per level) plus a 12-bit offset.

claims.claim_text: 稀疏配置讓一個已映射分頁只占約 12 KB，而不是攤平表格所需的 256 GiB
claims.evidence: For that one used page, I need one entry in the top-level table... That's roughly 12 KB total. Compare that to a flat table: 2^35 entries times 8 bytes equals 256 GiB.

claims.claim_text: TLB 容量說明
claims.evidence: If the working set fits within the TLB's capacity (typically a few hundred to a few thousand entries), translations stay cached and page walks are rare.

claims.claim_text: 分頁錯誤發生時核心才配置實體頁框並清零，這個延遲配置機制同時也是一種安全保證
claims.evidence: The kernel allocates a free physical frame … zero-fills that frame (the zero-fill guarantee, required for security...)

claims.claim_text: Fork 一開始靠 copy-on-write 讓親子行程共用實體頁框
claims.evidence: When either process subsequently writes to a COW-protected page, the MMU detects a write to a read-only PTE and raises a protection fault.

claims.claim_text: mmap() 則讓 PTE 直接指向核心的 page cache
claims.evidence: With mmap(), the process's PTE points directly into the page cache, eliminating that page-cache-to-user-buffer copy … cold pages still need faults to install mappings.

claims.claim_text: Modular 在 8 月 18 日把整個 Mojo 編譯器、工具鏈與標準函式庫原始碼放上 GitHub
claims.evidence: The source code for the Mojo compiler, tooling, and everything else you need to build the language are now available

claims.claim_text: 授權是 Apache 2.0 附 LLVM exceptions
claims.evidence: Apache 2.0 license (with LLVM exceptions)

claims.claim_text: 標準函式庫早在 2024 年就開放外部貢獻，其後又釋出「數十萬行用 Mojo 寫的 kernel 程式碼」
claims.evidence: hundreds of thousands of lines of kernel code written in Mojo

claims.claim_text: 一行 ./bazelw run --config=build-mojo 就能從原始碼編出編譯器
claims.evidence: ./bazelw run --config=build-mojo KGEN:mojo -- run hello.mojo

claims.claim_text: 官方目前仍限制外部貢獻編譯器本體，目標是「今年底前」開放
claims.note: 已改為「目標是」，恢復來源 aim to 的意向強度而非承諾。
claims.evidence: We aren't ready to take contributions to the compiler and tooling. We aim to accept contributions to the compiler and tooling by the end of this year, and we'll share more details when we can.

claims.claim_text: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 是正式版，取代先前的 preview
claims.evidence: the official release of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, superseding the preview version, with greatly enhanced agentic capabilities and performance improvements

claims.claim_text: 架構是 1.7 兆參數的 MoE，搭配 DSpark 模組做推測解碼
claims.evidence: 1.7T params … built on the DeepSeek-V4-Pro (Preview) model structure, with a DSpark speculative decoding module attached.

claims.claim_text: 高／max 推理力度下建議輸出長度上限 384K token
claims.note: 原「脈絡長度最高到百萬 token」無法在 model card 找到對應規格，已改為 card 實際給出的 384K 輸出長度建議。
claims.evidence: we recommend a maximum output length of 384K tokens for high/max reasoning effort

claims.claim_text: 官方說法是這一版「大幅強化 agentic 能力，生產環境的表現也有提升」
claims.evidence: greatly enhanced agentic capabilities and performance improvements that are especially pronounced in production environments

claims.claim_text: 並支援低、高、max 三種推理力度
claims.evidence: The `reasoning_effort` parameter now supports three levels — `low`, `high`, and `max`

claims.claim_text: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 拿下 87.9 分，Toolathlon-Verified 74.1 分，DSBench-FullStack 71.1 分
claims.evidence: Terminal Bench 2.1: 87.9 … Toolathlon-Verified: 74.1 … DSBench-FullStack: 71.1

claims.claim_text: 權重以 MIT 授權開放在 Hugging Face 上，部署建議走 vLLM 或 SGLang
claims.evidence: This repository and the model weights are licensed under the MIT License … For agentic scenarios … temperature = 1.0, with top_p = 0.95

claims.claim_text: sondehub.org 在 2018 年 5 月 12 日以玩笑心態註冊
claims.evidence: a joke redirect to Habhub with a radiosonde specific filter

claims.claim_text: 後來長成完整的探空氣球追蹤平台，帶自己的 API 與即時資料流
claims.evidence: By 2020/2021 we ended up doing was building backwards compatible APIs for the Habhub frontend … features like websockets and MQTT for live feeds.

claims.claim_text: 「反向預測」功能能從風場反推發射地點，意外連軍事砲兵陣地都能被標定出來
claims.evidence: With our own predictor running Mark developed a system we call reverse predictions... What we had started doing is accidentally mapping out artillery sites.

claims.claim_text: 2024 年 12 月服務開始遭遇類似 DDoS 的攻擊，分析發現預測請求集中在烏克蘭與俄羅斯邊境一帶
claims.evidence: In Dec 2024 - alarms in my inbox again. … Points on a map near the Ukraine/Russian border

claims.claim_text: 烏克蘭一方據稱把它用於無人機作戰，俄羅斯則像是在反過來攻擊這個服務
claims.evidence: that it might be russia DDOSing us because Ukranians might be using it to help drone operations

claims.claim_text: 美國軍方也大量介入，除了要資料還開了支援工單
claims.evidence: Since then we've many support requests from .mil and .gov addresses... In 2025 we received a request for data from the 'Office of the Secretary of War (Intelligence and Security)' (US).

claims.claim_text: 開發者後來寫了本地端的預測軟體降低對 API 的依賴
claims.evidence: I also quickly rushed together a docker compose file so anyone could quickly run their own predictor that wasn't reliant on us.

claims.claim_text: 向 AWS 求助時特別強調「服務中斷可能造成人命損失」
claims.evidence: Loss of life could occur.

claims.claim_text: startup／readiness／liveness 探針角色與 kubelet 發出
claims.evidence: Probes are sent by a process called the kubelet. Each node in the cluster has its own kubelet.

claims.claim_text: 「liveness 探針不應該在 startup 探針成功之前就先開火」，在 k3s、minikube、kind 上用 v1.36.2 都重現得出來
claims.evidence: Liveness probes shouldn't be firing before the startup probe has succeeded. I reproduced this in k3s, minikube, and kind against the latest Kubernetes at time of writing v1.36.2.

claims.claim_text: 看起來是 v1.35.0 引入的迴歸
claims.note: 已改為「看起來是」，恢復來源 appears to have been introduced 的 hedge 強度。
claims.evidence: The bug appears to have been introduced in v1.35.0.

claims.claim_text: failureThreshold 設太低會直接造成 crash-loop
claims.evidence: Too little time can cause a container to crash-loop... After a few restarts, pod-a is put in CrashLoopBackOff.

claims.claim_text: threshold=1 時「單一次暫時性失敗」就能讓 pod 被踢出 service，threshold=2 就安全得多
claims.evidence: I don't want a single transient failure to remove my pods from their Services... Below I've set the thresholds to 2.

claims.claim_text: periodSeconds 從 1 秒改成 5 秒，部署時間從約 11 秒拉長到 19、20 秒
claims.evidence: it takes about 11 seconds to finish... It now takes about 19-20 seconds for this rollout to complete
